newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq resumes downward trend, network stocks slip.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq resumes downward trend, network stocks slip.

text.p: Nasdaq shares resumed their downward trend on Tuesday as technology shares relinquished slight gains seen during Monday's session.

The Nasdaq composite index lost 5.95 points or 0.45 percent to an unofficial close of 1316.77. Nasdaq shares have fallen in three of the four most recent sessions. The Dow industrials gained almost six points to 7085.

"The OTC stocks have suffered. The smaller have lagged the big stocks for a while now. When the market is nervous, people play the big cap stocks. They're afraid of the smaller tier and second level stocks like the techs," one trader said.

Networking stocks suffered another blow Tuesday after Hambrecht & Quist downgraded key players such as Cisco Systems Inc and FORE Systems Inc. Cisco, the most active Nasdaq issue, shed 5/8 to 52-3/4, while Fore slipped 2-3/8 to 22-1/8.
Netscape Communications Corp lost 1-7/8 to 27-3/4 after Morgan Stanley said there is a 50 percent chance Netscape may fall short of first quarter earnings estimates.
Overall, losing issues beat gainers 2169 to 2037 on total volume of 584.5 million shares.
